description: Fork of exp213 (val_bpb=1.7670). Bug fix: per-layer pos_emb is now added ONLY at the Q/K input (ln_qk(x + pos_emb)), not propagated through the residual. The residual stream carries raw x; pos info is re-injected fresh at each layer's attention. (Previously x_pos = x + pos_emb was used as the residual, accumulating pos info across layers.)
